annotations.title: Whale alert, large transfers: big USDC and USDT moves on 5 networks

description: Large stablecoin transfers in the last minutes, read live from the network: every USDC and USDT transfer of at least min USD (default 100,000) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, largest first, with sender, receiver, transaction and block, mints and burns marked. Covers up to 15 minutes on Ethereum and 3 on Base (busiest). Addresses are not labelled. Use to watch whale flows, treasury moves or stablecoin mints. Example: chain=ethereum. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

min.description: Smallest transfer in USD, 10000 or more (default 100000)

minutes.description: How far back, 1 to 15 minutes (default 5; Base covers at most 3)
